siteSettings.title: English Adventures: Each Other - One Another - Ourselves

modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Pronouns Lessons
modules.instructions: Master the use of EACH OTHER, ONE ANOTHER (reciprocal) and OURSELVES (reflexive). Learn when to use each pronoun type.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Writing Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences using EACH OTHER, ONE ANOTHER, and OURSELVES correctly. Practice with reciprocal and reflexive contexts.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Grammar Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice choosing the correct pronoun based on number of people and type of relationship.

modules.name: Quiz
modules.title: Quick Quiz
modules.instructions: Test your knowledge with multiple choice questions about pronouns. Choose the correct reciprocal or reflexive pronoun!

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Pronouns Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply EACH OTHER, ONE ANOTHER, and OURSELVES correctly in sentences. Master reciprocal and reflexive usage.
